name: Bandung Zaman Now 2018

venue.name: [Click Square Mall Bandung](https://www.clicksquare.id/)
venue.details: The competition will be held on the 5th floor.

information:
This is the 8th competition in Bandung with the theme of "Bandung Zaman Now". Held to celebrate the wave of new cubers and the rise of Rubik's Cube community in Bandung. 

If you are new in WCA competition or having questions about regulation, please check [WCA Regulation (English)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) or [Regulasi WCA (Bahasa Indonesia, currently outdated)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/indonesian/)

The payment can be done by early bird or on the spot systems (please refer to 'Registration Fee & Payments' tab). During the registration, please add your phone number in the comment section. For more information, please contact the organizers.
